body_markdown:
“It was working yesterday.”


He said it like that settled everything.


Checked deployments… Nothing.
Checked flows… Found one named “Final_v3_Updated_NEW.” Not promising.
Checked logs…. There it was.


Validation rule firing from a field updated by a flow… triggered by another flow… tied to a field no one owns anymore.


Asked again when it broke.


“Yesterday.”


Fixed it in 10 minutes.


Probably hadn’t worked in months.
